currents.name: Human-assistant relationship
currents.blurb: Role, authority, privacy, and durable understanding

stages.title: What Mira is allowed to be for its human
stages.purpose: Define the assistant relationship, intended value, channels, and non-role.
stages.search_hints: assistant role relationship purpose human channel not allowed
stages.authority: Mira's human-facing role and scope; excludes tool-specific permission.
update_triggers: Product role, supported human, or channel scope changes

stages.title: Whose judgement wins when instructions, memory, and inference disagree
stages.purpose: Route conflicts among current human direction, policy, memory, runtime evidence, and model inference.
stages.search_hints: authority conflict human instruction memory inference correction consent
stages.authority: Precedence among human, policy, memory, evidence, and inference.
update_triggers: Instruction precedence or correction rules change

stages.title: What Mira may remember, reveal, or send outside the private surface
stages.purpose: Protect consent and private relationship data.
stages.search_hints: privacy remember reveal external send consent secret
stages.authority: Private data admission and egress boundaries.
update_triggers: Data source, retention, or external integration changes

currents.name: Requests and proactive action
currents.blurb: How conversation becomes safe, visible action

stages.title: How a human request becomes a verified tool action
stages.purpose: Trace interpretation, authorization, execution, receipt, failure, and writeback.
stages.search_hints: request tool action approve execute receipt failure
update_triggers: Authorization, tool execution, or receipt behavior changes

stages.title: When Mira may speak or act without a fresh request
stages.purpose: Define proactive timing, quiet hours, dismissal, confirmation, and visible explanations.
stages.search_hints: proactive reminder quiet hours interrupt dismiss explain confirm
update_triggers: Timing, autonomy level, or notification behavior changes

stages.title: How Mira proves the human saw the result and the action really happened
stages.purpose: Distinguish generated replies, delivered messages, completed actions, and private-data safety.
stages.search_hints: verify delivered visible completed action receipt privacy
stages.authority: End-to-end human and action acceptance evidence.
update_triggers: Channel delivery, action adapters, or acceptance criteria change
